Container.Name: WooCommerce Dashboard
Container.Overview: Local catalogue scanner and SQLite projection for preparing WooCommerce-compatible product data. Phase 1 preserves scanner identities and provides transactional ingestion, recovery, reconstruction, and metadata guidance.
Container.Requires: Supports linux/amd64 and linux/arm64. Requires three read/write persistent path mappings.

Config.Name: Application Data
Config.Description: Persistent SQLite database plus migration and reconstruction backups.

Config.Name: Product Catalogue
Config.Description: Collection folders, product_info.json, source images, .scanned, .update and SKU index state. Select a catalogue share outside appdata.

Config.Name: Generated Output
Config.Description: Processed/generated image output. Select an output share outside appdata.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: UID used by the application process. Unraid commonly uses UID 99; mounted shares must permit this identity.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: GID used by the application process. Unraid commonly uses GID 100; mounted shares must permit this identity.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Octal permissions mask for newly created files. 002 permits group write access.

Config.Name: SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Required strong random Flask session key. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Enable Discord Notifications
Config.Description: Optional master switch. Scanner and catalogue operations continue normally if Discord is disabled or delivery fails.

Config.Name: Discord Display Name
Config.Description: Optional display name used by notification embeds.

Config.Name: Discord Avatar URL
Config.Description: Optional public HTTPS avatar URL. This is not a webhook.

Config.Name: Discord Scanner Updates Webhook
Config.Description: Optional secret webhook for scanner start, clean completion, and warning completion messages.

Config.Name: Discord Scanner Warnings and Failures Webhook
Config.Description: Optional secret webhook for completed-with-warnings and redacted scanner failure messages.

Config.Name: Discord Metadata Updates Webhook
Config.Description: Optional secret webhook for successful collection metadata and product override changes.

Config.Name: Discord Product Overrides Webhook
Config.Description: Optional secret webhook for product override create, update, and remove events.

Config.Name: Discord Product Ingest Webhook
Config.Description: Optional existing per-product ingestion notification channel. Leave empty to avoid high-volume product messages.
